error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: An unexpected error occurred. Reloading the page should let you continue.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address does not exist, or it has changed.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.body: Your account is not permitted to view this page. If you think this is a mistake, contact your teacher.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.body: You need to set a new password before continuing.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter the email and password your teacher gave you.
login.failed: Could not sign in. Please try again.
login.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in is not available right now.
login.googleFailed: Google sign-in did not work. Please try again.
login.noSignup: Accounts are created by your teacher. If you have a class code, use the join link they sent you.
login.panelBlurb: An English practice platform built for your class.

join.title: Join a class
join.subtitle: Enter the class code your teacher sent you.
join.codeHint: 8 characters, for example K7M3-P9QR. Case does not matter.
join.googleExplainer: Your account will be created with Google. We only use your name and email.
join.failed: Could not join the class. Please try again.

errors.incomplete: The class code needs all 8 characters.
